caption: The drawing depicts a folded quilt with intricate patterns and multiple colors. The quilt is primarily composed of a large central star pattern, which is made up of small, repeating geometric shapes in shades of red, pink, and blue, over a pale beige or off-white background. Surrounding the central star is a wide border featuring alternating strips of floral and leafy designs. The floral strips are green with red and light pink flowers, while the leafy strips are a warm gold or mustard color with additional small red and pink flowers. The green areas have a linear background pattern, and the floral designs are outlined with fine detail. The quilt's texture and seams are visible, with quilting stitches forming diamond and star motifs in the light areas around the central star. The quilt is shown from a top-down perspective and appears neatly folded, with the layers visibly stacked along the left edge.
title: Quilt
